svg.title: From profile to adapters.
svg.text: Starts each task in its family's image, on its
model's instance type; at most 20 at once
First pass: SoundHub's IAM policies decide what the
job role (role_arn) can read. ROBIN keeps its own record.
Not an adapter: how the work is split into tasks
code names a module and function. At submit, the
CLI imports it and calls build(settings)
PostgreSQL, with an RDS IAM token
Made from the person's AWS login for
each connection; no password is stored
